description: This is a PHP source code file defining the AuthProviderDao class within an OpenID authentication plugin for the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for accessing, saving, and deleting OpenID provider data in the database.

classes.name: AuthProviderDao
classes.description: Data access object for managing OpenID authentication providers and related details within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getAuthProviderById
methods.description: Retrieves an OpenIdProvider entity by its provider ID.

methods.name: getAuthProviderDetailsByProviderId
methods.description: Fetches extra details for an authentication provider based on provider ID.

methods.name: getAuthProviders
methods.description: Returns a list of authentication providers filtered by search parameters.

methods.name: getAuthProvidersPaginator
methods.description: Builds and returns a paginator for the list of authentication providers based on search filters.

methods.name: getAuthProviderCount
methods.description: Counts the number of authentication providers matching search criteria.

methods.name: deleteProviders
methods.description: Deletes (deactivates) providers given their IDs.

methods.name: saveProvider
methods.description: Persist an OpenIdProvider entity to the database.

methods.name: saveAuthProviderExtraDetails
methods.description: Persist extra details related to an authentication provider.

methods.name: getAuthProvidersForLoginPage
methods.description: Returns active OpenID providers available for login.

methods.name: saveUserIdentity
methods.description: Persist an OpenIdUserIdentity entity.

methods.name: getAuthProviderById
methods.description: Retrieves an OpenIdProvider entity by ID.

methods.name: getAuthProviderDetailsByProviderId
methods.description: Fetches extra details for an auth provider by ID.

methods.name: getAuthProviders
methods.description: Retrieves a list of auth providers filtered by search criteria.

methods.name: getAuthProvidersPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for the list of auth providers.

methods.name: getAuthProviderCount
methods.description: Counts auth providers matching filters.

methods.name: deleteProviders
methods.description: Marks providers as inactive given their IDs.

methods.name: saveProvider
methods.description: Saves a provider entity.

methods.name: saveAuthProviderExtraDetails
methods.description: Saves extra details for a provider.

methods.name: getAuthProvidersForLoginPage
methods.description: Returns active providers for login.

methods.name: saveUserIdentity
methods.description: Saves a user identity entity.
